from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name the data belongs to")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the document, e.g., '2023 Q1'")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric item")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific date the value represents, e.g., '2022-12-31'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 'CNY'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_data: list[FinancialMetric]
